title: Add Sortable List
content: Create sortable list. Container: space-y-2. List item: bg-white p-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm flex items-center gap-3, cursor-grab. Drag handle: 6-dot grid icon (grip), text-gray-400. Item content: flex-1. Drag state: shadow-lg scale-105 opacity-90. Drop indicator: border-2 border-blue-500 border-dashed between items.

variants.detailed: Create sortable list. Container: space-y-2. List item: bg-white p-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm flex items-center gap-3, cursor-grab. Drag handle: 6-dot grid icon (grip), text-gray-400. Item content: flex-1. Drag state: shadow-lg scale-105 opacity-90. Drop indicator: border-2 border-blue-500 border-dashed between items.
variants.advanced: Create full-featured sortable list. Implementation: @dnd-kit/sortable or similar. Items: unique id required, render content via render prop or children. Drag handle: optional dedicated handle vs whole item draggable, grip icon. Drag activation: pointer down + delay, or immediate. Drag preview: lifted item follows cursor, scale up slightly, shadow increases. Drop zones: visual indicator of drop position, animate other items moving aside. Constraints: optional axis lock (vertical only), boundary limits. Accessibility: keyboard reorder (Space to pick up, arrows to move, Space to drop), screen reader announcements ("Picked up item 3", "Dropped in position 2"). Multi-select: checkbox to select multiple, drag selection together. Groups/sections: sortable within sections, optionally between sections. Animation: smooth transitions using CSS transforms, configurable duration. Events: onReorder callback with old and new indices/order. Undo: optional undo after reorder. Disabled items: some items not draggable. External drop: accept drops from outside the list. Nested: sortable lists within sortable items. Touch: long press to activate drag on mobile, haptic feedback optional. Performance: virtualized list for many items.
